name: Lokud 7
description: Lokud 7 was a jungle world in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Galactic Civil War, Rebel Alliance spies landed on Lokud 7 with Imperial intelligence. Darth Vader followed the Rebel spies to the planet in search of them.
